summary: SLA cohort entropy detector flagged mismatched autoroute weights causing misrouted P2 traffic
description: Issue summary: The SLA cohort entropy detector alarm fired in prod-us-east indicating a sudden increase in cohort entropy for the P2 priority buckets. Impact: Approximately 4-6% of P2 traffic was routed to lower-priority handlers during the window 2026-02-20T09:12Z - 2026-02-20T09:44Z, causing increased end-to-end ticket touch times and two customer escalations. Observed behaviour: cohort entropy spike + routing-policy evaluation shows unexpected weight redistribution to legacy 'fallback' bindings. System components involved: rule-engine (autoroute compiler), enrichment-service (cohort tagging), reporting-pipeline (entropy detector).
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Deploy routing snapshot from 2026-02-19 to staging with the same policy version used in prod. 2) Replay sample traffic matching P2 cohort signature for 60 minutes via replayer tool. 3) Observe autoroute weight assignments in /api/v1/routing/snapshot/<id>/evaluate and compare to expected. 4) Run 'cohort-reconcile job' manually and inspect logs for 'weight_decay' or 'ghost_binding' markers.
investigation_notes:
- Initial hypothesis: recent template merge changed inheritance precedence for 'escalation-window' macros; this caused the rule-compiler to emit a fallback binding with non-zero weight.
- Checked compiler output for snapshot 2026-02-19T22:58Z: found an unexpected binding 'fallback-legacy-v2' with weight 0.05 for P2 cohort which should be zero.
- Enrichment logs show cohort tags were stable; no spike in input distribution.
- Telemetry shows a correlated spike in 'autoroute.evaluation.latency' around 09:11Z which aligns with a burst of config reloads from autoscaler.
- Reproducer in staging failed to show mismatch until we toggled 'template-inheritance-strict' flag; with flag off the compiler reproduced weight leakage.
- Possible root cause: compiler change in PR 842 (related_github_prs) introduced a fast-path that bypasses zero-weight pruning when 'inherit_from' chain length >3.
- Additional evidence: metric 'routing.snapshot.diff.bindings_added' is non-zero for snapshot bump operations that should be pure metadata updates.
workaround: 1) Revert to snapshot 2026-02-18 for autoroute compiler in prod-us-east (temporary rollback). 2) Set 'template-inheritance-strict' feature flag to true to enforce zero-weight pruning until fix is deployed. 3) Notify On-Call SRE to monitor 'routing.bindings.zero-weight' metric and mute cohort entropy alerts for the short rollback window.
resolution: (in progress) Temporary rollback to snapshot 2026-02-18 completed at 2026-02-20T11:05Z; cohort entropy returned to baseline. Engineering is preparing a targeted patch to the rule-compiler that adds explicit zero-weight pruning and a unit test covering multi-level inheritance. Plan: merge patch, push canary to prod-us-east with 10% rollout, validate telemetry for 24 hours, then full rollout. Follow-ups: add an integration test to replayer that checks for non-zero weights on fallback bindings and add a dashboard panel for 'routing.snapshot.diff.bindings_added'.
